work.description: The act accepts Nicholas Foran's renunciation and provides George Browne to the new see of Galway. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7754; own dating clause LF7894–7897 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo pri- mo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF7776 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
